audit.why: spikes[] correctly identify lvl3-5 (Lucian's passive+E dash), lvl6 (skill-decided Culling vs Buster Shot), 1st item (his passive spike still wins), and late (your scaling flips it).

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Lucian's Lightslinger passive lets him sustain chip damage without Grievous Wounds, and that his combo opens with an auto-attack reset rather than a spell cast — neither is stated anywhere on the page.
audit.why: P-Lightslinger doubles Lucian's next attack after an ability, immobilize, heal, or shield — the wind-up tell is the reset auto, not the spell. Without anti-heal timed right, spaced poke just gets healed/sustained back.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now states the auto-reset tell; dontsFull[2].d now states the anti-heal/sustain problem with trading at range.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged 'Relentless Pursuits' and 'Use Relentless Pursuit' as possible wrong names, but both are the correct ability name (Relentless Pursuit) used inline — false positives, no fix needed.

edits.before: Contest level 1 autos — your early range is real and the all-in threat starts at 2; set the tone.
edits.after: His double-shot Lightslinger passive and superior short-trade damage win level 1 autos outright.

edits.before: Jump-bomb all-ins open: W in off any support CC and the E detonation math is already rude.
edits.after: His Piercing Light plus the double-shot passive out-trades your step-up last-hitting at level 2.

edits.before: Full kit: E the target, stack it with autos, and R the finish — the lane's most honest kill threat.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit dodges your Rocket Jump and lets him re-kite you the moment you commit.

edits.before: Trade around the bomb: four stacks detonate — back off at three or commit at four; never linger between.
edits.after: His mobility and burst keep beating you every time you contest CS through levels 4-5.

edits.before: First item spike: the jump-bomb-R string deletes squishies and the resets chain through fights.
edits.after: His first-item spike with the passive is one of the strongest in the game and still beats yours.

edits.before: Late Trist jumps the resets: E the carry, R the peel, and jump out — or in — on every takedown.
edits.after: Your Rocket Jump range steroid and Explosive Charge scaling outrange his faded lane power at 2+ items.

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash — lock him down while it is on cooldown. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Rocket Jump (reset) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Lucian's E-Relentless Pursuit is down 16s early, 14s at max rank — his only dash; lock him down while it's on cooldown, not while it's up. - Guard your W Rocket Jump (reset) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: E the bomb, stack two autos, and step back at three — the threat does the zoning and the fourth stack stays loaded.
edits.after: His combo opens with a Lightslinger reset auto, not a spell cast — the wind-up on that auto is your cue to back off, before the real damage lands.

edits.before: Jumping in with the bomb unstacked and R down — Tristana without the string is a yordle tourist at a gunfight.
edits.after: He sustains chip poke through Lightslinger's bonus damage — without Grievous Wounds timed right, trading at range just heals him back up.

edits.before: You are the reset carry: jump in on the pick, R the peel, and jump out on the takedown — or don't, and take the tower instead.
edits.after: You outscale him late: flank with W onto a squishy, detonate E, and reset off every takedown — his short range can't keep up.
